initiatives.name: Zaldívar Environmental Impact Assessment Approval
initiatives.summary: In May 2025, Chilean authorities approved the Environmental Impact Assessment for Zaldívar Mine Life Extension and Water Transition Project. This approval enables operational continuity until 2051 and allows transition to alternative water sources by 2028.

evidence.title: Zaldívar Environmental Impact Assessment Approval

initiatives.name: Major Financing Secured for Growth Projects
initiatives.summary: The company secured significant financing totaling $3.5 billion in 2025 to fund major expansion projects. This included $2 billion for Los Pelambres' desalination plant expansion, $600 million corporate bond for Centinela's Second Concentrator Project, and $900 million for Los Pelambres' concentrate pipeline and El Mauro enclosures project.

evidence.title: Major Financing Secured for Growth Projects
evidence.summary: The company secured significant financing totaling $3.5 billion in 2025 to fund major expansion projects. This included $2 billion for Los Pelambres' desalination plant expansion, $600 million corporate bond for Centinela's Second Concentrator Project, and $900 million for Los Pelambres' concentrate pipeline and El Mauro enclosures project.
evidence.quote: Significant milestones in 2025 included the $2 billion financing (including bank financing and a private placement bond with a 20-year term) secured in March 2025 in connection with Los Pelambres' expansion of its desalination plant, issuing a $600 million corporate bond in September 2025 in support of sponsor contributions for Centinela's Second Concentrator Project, and a $900 million corporate loan facility secured by Los Pelambres in November 2025 to complete the financing requirements for its new concentrate pipeline and El Mauro enclosures Project.

evidence.title: Centinela Second Concentrator Project Construction
evidence.summary: The Second Concentrator Project at Centinela continues construction after commencing in April 2024. Work in 2025 focused on assembly of mining equipment, installation of structural steel, and assembly of mechanical equipment, with the project progressing on time and on budget.
evidence.quote: The Projects Committee has maintained rigorous oversight of the project, monitoring progress across key areas including construction milestones, safety performance and the management of capital expenditures. The project continues to progress on time and on budget. Work in 2025 focused on the assembly of key mining equipment at the Esperanza Sur mine, the installation of structural steel for the concentrator, the assembly of mechanical equipment for the concentrate thickeners, and the assembly of ball mill components.
